metadata.anchor_selection: Three separated, non-collinear surface tracks from frame 361 whose co-motion was checked across the saved demo segment; not semantic task landmarks.
metadata.frame_rule: origin=A; X=unit(B-A); Y=unit((C-A)-dot(C-A,X)X); Z=X cross Y
metadata.propagation: Each frame fits a rigid transform using all currently supported TrackEverything points, then applies it to fixed A/B/C reference coordinates.
metadata.limitation: This is within-demo propagation only. A live run still needs demonstrated cross-episode material-point correspondence; a rigid fit can also be wrong under occlusion.
